name: Wasabi Protocol
what_changed: Deployer key (wasabideployer.eth = 0x5c629f8c0b5368f523c85bfe79d2a8efb64fb0c8) was compromised; grantRole delay was 0 and there was no multisig or timelock, so the attacker pushed UUPS upgrades and used them immediately. In this single tx the WasabiLongPool proxy was upgraded from 0x8e19c040... (set 2026-02-25) to the malicious 0x1f392a1f... and drained ~226 ETH via strategyDeposit into an attacker-controlled fake strategy. Separately, 8 ETH vault proxies were drained via admin strategyDeposit without upgrade events (vault drain tx 0xcd77423f...). loss_usd is the ~$2.55M Ethereum leg ($2M vault drain + LongPool); protocol total ~$5.9M across Ethereum/Base/Berachain/Blast.
source: https://rekt.news/wasabi-protocol-rekt; QuillAudits report; on-chain Upgraded logs on 0x8e0edfd6... (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: Zoth
what_changed: Admin key was compromised and the USD0PPSubVaultUpgradeable proxy was swapped from 0x7cb771ca... (set 2025-03-03) to malicious 0xc89d7894...; the attacker then used privileged functions of the new implementation to withdraw 8.85M USD0++ (~$8.4M).
source: https://rekt.news/zoth-rekt; SlowMist and Cyvers alerts; on-chain Upgraded logs (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: Radiant Capital
what_changed: The 3/11 Safe multisig was compromised via INLETDRIFT malware; in the attack tx the attacker transferred ownership of the lending pool proxy and upgraded it from 0x453213a0... to a malicious implementation (0xf0c0a1a1..., deployed ~14 days earlier by 0x57ba8957... on Arbitrum/BSC/Base), then drained the pools. The same attack drained the BSC deployment (tx 0xd97b93f633aee356d992b49193e60a571b8c466bf46aaf072368f975dc11841c). loss_usd is the combined BSC+Arbitrum total of $50M+; no clean per-chain split was published.
source: https://rekt.news/radiant-capital-rekt2; Radiant Capital post-mortem; on-chain receipt/getLogs via arb1.arbitrum.io RPC (Upgraded event in attack tx; prior impl at block 240495655)

name: Bedrock uniBTC
what_changed: Legitimate upgrade set implementation 0xc0c9e78b... whose mint() minted uniBTC 1:1 against native ETH deposits (code written for BTC-native chains, deployed to Ethereum). Exploited on 2024-09-08 (attack tx 0x725f0d65340c859e0f64e72ca8260220c526c3e0ccde530004160809f6177940) by minting ~1,200 uniBTC from flash ETH deposits (~$1.8-2M; loss_usd uses the ~$2M estimate). Dedaub disclosed the root cause pre-exploit and said the vulnerable contract was deployed 'under two days' before the exploit, so whether the Jul 11 or Aug 19 upgrade introduced the bug is not fully pinned - 0xc0c9e78b was the implementation active at exploit time. Post-attack fix upgrade to 0xcb674fbb... on 2024-10-01.
source: Dedaub Bedrock disclosure (dedaub.com); on-chain Upgraded log history of 0x047d41f2... (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: Pike Finance
what_changed: Storage-layout / initialized-variable misalignment let the attacker re-initialize the contract and use Pike's upgradeToAndCall path to install a malicious implementation (prev_impl 0xb30c120e... had been set 2024-04-28), then drain funds; ~$1.6M on the Ethereum leg of a multi-chain attack (~$1.9M total including OP/ARB legs).
source: https://rekt.news/pike-rekt; on-chain Upgraded logs on 0xfc7599cf... (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: Unizen
what_changed: Buggy (not malicious) upgrade by the team itself: a gas-optimization revision of the Trade Aggregator introduced an unverified external call, letting an attacker invoke the aggregator to drain tokens from users holding approvals (~$2.1M). The team rolled back to the previous implementation 0xf92ecf88... on 2024-03-09T02:55:59Z (tx 0x926600e07748c7555ec3e5e99883241c8d669524d7770c2d5df12920ae8f7817).
source: https://rekt.news/unizen-rekt; on-chain Upgraded logs on 0xd3f64baa... (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: OKX DEX
what_changed: The ProxyAdmin owner key (0xc82ea2af...) was compromised; the owner pushed two malicious upgrades the same night - first to 0x5c4794d9... (21:57:07 UTC, this tx), then to 0xf36c407f... (23:13:59 UTC, tx 0xc6a5a7bc31bbc9a7530189e718f7ed96789fa65c56c3a4a08079a95074e280c8). The new implementations could invoke claimTokens on the OKX DEX contract (0x70cbb871...), siphoning tokens from wallets that had approved the deprecated proxy; ~$2.7M drained (attacker 0xfacf375a...).
source: https://rekt.news/okx-dex-rekt (SlowMist analysis); on-chain Upgraded log history of 0x55b35bf6... (Routescan Etherscan API)

name: DeltaPrime
what_changed: The compromised admin EOA 0x40e4ff9e018462ce71fa34abdfa27b8c5e2b1afb upgraded five DepositIndex proxies to one malicious implementation (0xd4ca224a...) within 8 blocks (04:14:02-04:14:04 UTC): 0x56f67141..., 0x7789bff8..., 0x5c671dae..., this proxy, and 0x8894df06... (txs 0x2e6748e9..., 0xbf4a57c5..., 0xc5262ec8..., this tx, 0xda785b1d...). The malicious DepositIndex logic allowed artificial interest inflation, draining the Savings pools for $5.98M. prev_impl was recovered from the team's own restore transaction 0x459ac0dfe1ed05074612e839a9f739f8770b68e3416eac59852278f7a82a60dc (~06:50 UTC), whose Upgraded event returned this proxy to 0x2af68733...
source: DeltaPrime post-mortem (medium.com/@DeltaPrimeDefi/deltaprime-post-mortem-reimbursement-plan-3e5d6086dd2e); Merkle Science flow-of-funds analysis; on-chain receipts/logs via arb1.arbitrum.io RPC
